Checkatrade Reviews From Grimsby

After 3 Attempts by Another Builder

Roof watertight following 3 previous attempts by another builder.

The company provided a break down of work being undertaken and a detailed quote. They arrived promptly on the first day and completed the job where possible on schedule. Overnight a storm caused the tarpaulin to become dislodged and there was some water ingress which when informed they attended to immediately. I was impressed by their regard to their work ethic and health & safety on the job. They were friendly throughout. Due to the weather they were unable to complete part of the job and reduced the cost accordingly with a view to returning at a future date to complete the work.

Verified Checkatrade customer, Grimsby (DN36). Checkatrade review, 6 January 2026

installed a new rubber flat roof ,capped my chimney & installed a new velux window

the guys were brilliant, finished the job a day ahead of schedule. clean and very professional

Quick, Friendly, Professional

Needed my chimney looking at after hearing a drip from inside the breast. Came out quick to take a look and let me know exactly what needed doing. Gave a fair price and got the job done a few days later. Very friendly and professional throughout and did the job to a high standard. Would recommend to anyone who needs similar work done.
